issues.description: The Problem Statement requires Book.author to be a String (a book consists of two Strings: title and author). In the solution repository the Book struct declares author as a Bool (let author: Bool). This conflicts with the specification and with the Client code in the solution which constructs Book instances using String author values and prints the author. The mismatch will cause compilation errors and prevents students from following the intended design.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the type of Book.author in solution_repository/Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift from Bool to String (e.g. `let author: String`) so it matches the problem specification and the Client usage. Ensure any other references/use-sites expecting a String remain consistent.
